> It seems like we should already have validation for this: [41b6e16](https://github.com/openshift/installer/commit/41b6e162aed357a35f29f7b3393c2f7dcbba07b6)

Talking with @fracappa on slack: I agree pkg/types is a better place for this. We don't want to duplicate this logic within the installer, so moving the existing logic to pkg/types seems like a win.

> > It seems like we should already have validation for this: [41b6e16](https://github.com/openshift/installer/commit/41b6e162aed357a35f29f7b3393c2f7dcbba07b6)
> 
> Talking with @fracappa on slack: I agree pkg/types is a better place for this. We don't want to duplicate this logic within the installer, so moving the existing logic to pkg/types seems like a win.

Hm, I realize now that I think I steered you wrong with this comment: `pkg/types` is indeed the best place for this, but I believe we need it in `pkg/asset` because ZTP provisioning does not necessarily use an install config. So it seems we need the validation in both places.

@danmanor Could you please check if the current location of the validation is OK for the assisted install path? You had reviewed my earlier https://github.com/openshift/installer/pull/9048 that restricted SNO installs to supported platforms. This PR adds an install-config validation for SNO installs on BareMetal platform so that we can reject that early.
@sadasu Assisted Installer uses `none` platform for SNO so it should be fine, I triggered e2e job to make sure
